svg.aria-label: Figure 2.1: Regional cartographic map of the Nile Corridor and Giza Supply Network around 2560 BCE, showing the Mediterranean Sea, Red Sea, Gulf of Suez, Nile Delta, narrow Nile Valley, two-way river current and prevailing wind highway, Kom el-Hisn livestock herds, detail inset of Giza, Tura, Memphis, Saqqara, and Dahshur, Wadi al-Jarf harbor and Sinai copper mines, Hierakonpolis, and Aswan granite quarries at the First Cataract.
svg.text: Figure 2.1: The Nile Corridor & Giza Supply Network (c. 2560 BCE)
A single 600-mile (1,000 km) two-way river highway carrying limestone, red granite, copper ore, and Delta herds to Giza
